name: Timor-Leste

fees.name: Tourist Visa (visa on arrival / issuance)
fees.applies: most nationalities not exempt (Portugal, USA and Timorese nationals on Portuguese passports are visa-exempt for tourism)
fees.notes: Fee is USD $30, payable in cash, usually collected on arrival at Presidente Nicolau Lobato International Airport or Dili Sea Port. No e-visa system exists as of 2026-07-02; land border entrants for most nationalities must obtain a Visa Application Authorization in advance but pay the same fee on arrival.

fees.name: Tourist Visa Extension
fees.notes: May be extended once for a further 30 days at USD $40.

fees.name: Business Visa Class II (VNG2)
fees.validity: 6 months initial, extendable up to 2 years, multiple entries
fees.applies: foreigners intending to establish/operate a business

fees.name: Transit Visa
fees.validity: Max 72 hours, up to two entries
fees.notes: Extension fee also USD $20, generally not permitted except under article 51 exceptions.

free_visa_notes: Portuguese and United States nationals, and Timorese nationals holding Portuguese passports, are exempt from visa requirements for tourism. No reciprocity-based fee schedule (e.g. differing amounts for IND, GBR, CHN, etc.) was found on official sources; the flat USD fee schedule above applies uniformly to non-exempt nationalities. No official e-visa or eTA system exists as of 2026-07-02; all listed fees are collected via on-arrival/embassy processing by the Immigration Service of Timor-Leste. No VFS/TLScontact/BLS outsourced visa centre found for Timor-Leste.
